title: Al Casey, the kid at Fats's house, and Fats finding Autrey at Small's
summary: Fats used guitarist Al Casey, who came to play with his children, and Autrey because he had heard him at Small's.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And from -- I gather from what you tell me, Herman, that the six-piece group was put together awfully casually, just what, a day or two before the date? Got you --
: He got you, and he got --
Well, he got me, guitar player --
: Had he worked with Al before?

Well, no. Well Al, Al used to come around to his house a lot, and play with his children, his kids, you know. And Al was a kid himself at that time. You know, a little boy. And Al would come around there and play his guitar, and Fats would throw him a few crumbs, you know, show him no, do this, hit this chord, hit that chord. So then the thing come up for Fats to do some recording, Fats said well, I'll use you. Do this, do this, and do what I tell you, and Fats used him on the dates. You know.
: So he used Al, who he had known, and he used you, I mean just --
Well he met -- met for the first
Yeah, 'cause he saw and heard me down at Smalls Paradise. I was working down there.
